# Johnston Software Development

> Johnston Software Development Inc. (JSD) is a software development company in Oshawa, Ontario, Canada, founded in 2020 by full-stack developer Derek Johnston. It builds custom web applications and mobile apps and provides technical consulting for businesses in Oshawa and Durham Region, Ontario, and works remotely with clients worldwide.

Contact: Derek@JohnstonSoftwareDevelopment.ca, +1 905-926-8279. Contact form: https://johnstonsoftwaredevelopment.ca/contact/

## Services

- [Web Development](https://johnstonsoftwaredevelopment.ca/services/web/): Custom web apps, e-commerce, CMS and business dashboards built with Vue.js, Nuxt, React, Next.js and Node.js. Typical timeline 4-12 weeks.
- [Mobile App Development](https://johnstonsoftwaredevelopment.ca/services/mobile/): iOS, Android and cross-platform apps with Flutter and React Native, from build to App Store / Google Play launch and ongoing support. Typical timeline 6-16 weeks.
- [Technical Consulting](https://johnstonsoftwaredevelopment.ca/services/consulting/): Software architecture, code audits, performance tuning, legacy modernization and team mentoring. Hourly, project-based or retainer.
